### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**4** anchor(s) derived from **2** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them, so this run has **nothing to list** — **not a clean bill of health**. This check sees only pages that NAME a derived anchor: one that documents this change in prose, or enumerates it in an authoring dialect, names none and stays invisible to it on every run.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **172** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json b005638268828ffdef8819f04b141a13296e7de4` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `aa1398f0084696194a6b48193188dc58e894fb44` — the merge of head `2e0174a80638baa46bfd1b70fd73b12c5b6d864c` into base `b005638268828ffdef8819f04b141a13296e7de4`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin aa1398f0084696194a6b48193188dc58e894fb44 && git checkout aa1398f0084696194a6b48193188dc58e894fb44
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin b005638268828ffdef8819f04b141a13296e7de4 2e0174a80638baa46bfd1b70fd73b12c5b6d864c && git checkout -B drift-repro b005638268828ffdef8819f04b141a13296e7de4 && git merge --no-ff 2e0174a80638baa46bfd1b70fd73b12c5b6d864c

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json b005638268828ffdef8819f04b141a13296e7de4
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `2238c90f43bd2269dcd2b1dbabfda56d5d515af3`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/data/hook.form.ts + packages/spec/src/system/metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts

Inputs read: card #33657 (body and comments 6889955794, 6891882852, 6892138272, 6893270996, 6893283751), PR #33796 (body, 21 files, net diff of `origin/main...2238c90f`, merge base `bd96ec9c`), and the check-runs on the head. Code outside the diff was read on `origin/main` (`b76df9a6`), which changes none of the files cited below since the merge base.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Published surface.** `hookForm` (exported from `@objectstack/spec/data`) gains two sub-rows on the `refusals` entry: `reasons` (`type: 'record'`, `widget: 'key-only-record'`, one required `message` textarea) and `params` (`type: 'tags'`). Nothing is removed or renamed. A widening: right.
- **Accept set.** `HookSchema` / `HookRefusalSchema` (`hook.zod.ts:412-477` on main) are not in the diff. What a hook may store is unchanged: right.
- **Form-only direction.** Both new rows name keys `HookRefusalSchema` declares (`reasons` at `:439`, `params` at `:449`), and the nested `message` is the one key `HookRefusalReasonSchema` declares (`:361`). No control is offered whose value the schema discards: right.
- **Ledger.** The two `omit` rows for `hook` / `refusals` are deleted and no row replaces them. The reconciliation walk is recursive (`entry.fields[*].fields`), so `refusals` and `refusals.reasons` are now both reconciled with no excuse: right, pending the `Test Core` shards (below).
- **Translation paths.** The bundles key the new rows as `refusals.reasons`, `refusals.reasons.message` and `refusals.params`. `translateFormField` (`i18n-resolver.ts:5619`) accumulates the dotted path through every `fields` level, so the depth-three key resolves: right.
- **Gates at read time.** `completed/success`: Lint & Repo Gates, Lint · ESLint, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · CI, release & engine gates, the three `Lint · scoped` runs, Type Check · source gates, Type Check · debt ledger, Spec property liveness, Check Changeset, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Check PR Size, Build UI Deps, Dogfood Regression Gate, Flag docs affected by code changes, both shard planners. **`in_progress`, no conclusion yet:** Build Core, Test Core 1/8 to 8/8, Test UI 1/16 to 16/16, Type Check · workspace, Type Check · consumer gates, Type Check UI, Lint UI, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI. The reconciliation test and both ui pin files run inside the unfinished shards, so their verdict on this head is not in yet. This record does not stand in for them: landing waits for every check to end green.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/33657-hook-form-refusal-reasons-params.md` names `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/console` at `patch`, and carries both declaration lines, matching the PR body.

Clause-②: yes (widening) is correct: the published `hookForm` value changes and only gains.
Metadata-protocol: none is correct: `reasons` and `params` were already accepted by `HookRefusalSchema`, so no key, value or type is added to what an author can write. Under AGENTS.md's rule the kind `none` takes `patch`. The level matches what the diff publishes.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **`open_questions`:** none in the os-dev-report (6893270996). Nothing to answer.
- **Deviation, file surface beyond the claim** (eleven metadata-form bundles, the `fr` source-hash line, three census pins, `metadata-form-zh-cn.ts`): answered by the seat's amendment 6893283751. These are the lane seat's ACCEPT, not reviewed here.
- **Deviation, four packages at `patch`:** judged in ②, correct.
- **Deviation, a new per-card pin file:** a test placement, the lane seat's ACCEPT.
- **Deviation, a stray `/ablA.pid` at the filesystem root:** outside the repository and outside the diff. No contract effect.
- **Out-of-scope finding, `carrier: none`:** the `refusals` row's help text still ends "JavaScript (L2) bodies only". Escalated as nit N1 in ④: it owes a carrier.
- **Tier named in the amendment.** Comment 6893283751 says a `TIER_DEFAULT` declaration-face record is owed. `packages/spec/src/data/hook.form.ts` is a non-test file under `packages/spec/src/**`, so the face is the published schema and the record owed is this one, at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`.
- **Author:** the PR's `user.login` is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`. No off-relay note.
- **SQL pushdown:** the diff adds no data access. Nothing to record.
- **Draft:** the PR is a draft at read time.

### ④ Design judgment

**`packages/spec/src/data/hook.form.ts`**, against `HookRefusalSchema` on main, the card's ask and the renderer that is its first consumer (`SchemaForm.tsx` `RecordField`, read at the head, unchanged by this diff).

What holds:

- The row comment "the key rule each level checks is the one its served schema declares" agrees with the code. On the key-only face `RecordField` takes its key rule from `servedRecordKeyPattern(schema)` (`SchemaForm.tsx:3097`, `:3210`), and the nested row's `schema` is `pickSubSchema(schema, 'record', 'reasons')` (`:3416`, `:2647`), the `reasons` node under the catalogue's `additionalProperties.properties`. `reasons` is a `z.record` keyed by `HOOK_REFUSAL_REASON_PATTERN` (`hook.zod.ts:439-441`). The form restates no rule.
- `message` help text ("Plain text, unless the entry declares params: then a {{ name }} hole fills a declared param") agrees with `hookRefusalMessageRefusal` (`hook.zod.ts:379-384`).
- `reasons.message` help text ("Its {{ }} holes follow the entry's params") agrees with the `superRefine` loop at `hook.zod.ts:473-476`.
- `params` as `tags`: the control emits a string array and drops repeats; a non-identifier and a repeated name are refused at save by `HookRefusalSchema` (`:449-452`, `:460-468`). Loud, and no rule is restated.
- An entry the author does not touch keeps exactly its stored members: `updateItem` writes `{ ...entry, ...patch }` and nothing seeds the new rows (`SchemaForm.tsx:3226-3232`).
- Nested ids stay unique (`joinIdPath` appends the item index at each level), and a drag inside the nested list does not move the outer list (each `RecordField` holds its own `dragKey`).

Findings:

- **S1, should-fix. `packages/spec/src/data/hook.form.ts:64-71`: the form can store `reasons: {}`, which is not "absent", and cannot take it back.** Read from the code, not run. Removing the last reason calls `removeItem` (`SchemaForm.tsx:3233-3239`), which emits `{}`; the entry's `updateItem` then writes `reasons: {}` into the code's entry. No step between the form and the save drops an empty record, and `HookRefusalSchema` keeps it. The schema and the runtime both tell an empty `reasons` apart from a missing one: at save, `if (!reasons || hasOwnProperty…) continue` (`hook.zod.ts:329-335`) refuses every literal `reason` the body throws under that code; at run time `declaredAnswer` (`packages/runtime/src/sandbox/hook-refusal-catalogue.ts:279-283`) answers a computed one with a fault. Under a code with no `reasons` the same throw is ignored, which is the compatibility `HookRefusalSchema` promises ("a thrown `reason` is not read, as before"). So an author who adds a reason and deletes it again has changed how the hook answers, on a screen that shows the same empty list as before and whose help text says "Absent: a thrown reason is not read". The form offers no way back to absent. The same holds for any stored entry whose last reason is deleted in Studio. `params: []` is harmless (`hook.zod.ts:380` and the runtime both read an empty list as none). Either the nested row returns the member to absent when its last key goes, or the help text and a pin say what an emptied list means; the choice is the lane's, and the fix earns a delta review.
- **N1, nit. `packages/spec/src/data/hook.form.ts:59`** (unchanged line, same row): "JavaScript (L2) bodies only" has been false against `HookSchema` since #33641 ("a js body or a handler", `hook.zod.ts:843-844`), and this form offers `handler` at `:83`. Not introduced here and no effect on what is stored. The dev noted it with `carrier: none`; it needs a follow-up card.
- **N2, nit. `packages/spec/src/data/hook.form.ts:67`**: "a reason not declared here is refused" drops the schema's "loudly" and does not say when (at save for a literal throw, otherwise when the hook runs). Accurate as far as it goes; an accepted deviation.

**`packages/spec/src/system/metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts`** (implementing: the gate that enforces the form against the schema). Deleting the two `omit` rows at `:194-206` is the card's ask, and it makes the gate stricter: with no row, a `refusals` key the form does not offer fails by name, and the walk reaches `refusals.reasons` as its own coordinate. The deleted comment's reason ("a Studio change of its own") no longer describes the tree, so removing it with the rows is right. No finding. Its green on this head is still owed by the `Test Core` shards.

One should-fix and two nits; no must-fix.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `d3ff3bdbe9d993dc085875193bacc72c9e187724`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/data/hook.form.ts + ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/SchemaForm.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.hookRefusalReasons-33657.test.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/SchemaForm.keyOnlyRecord-26835.test.tsx, packages/spec/src/system/metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts

Delta review of S1 (record ID: 6893396284), taken on handoff 6894324874 under claim 6894340140. That record judged head `2238c90f43bd2269dcd2b1dbabfda56d5d515af3`; this one judges what moved since.

Inputs read: PR #33796 (body, 22 files, comments 6893271437, 6893396284, 6894324874), card #33657, the diff `2238c90f..d3ff3bdb`, the files it touches at the head, and the head's check-runs. Code outside the diff was read at the head.

What moved: one commit, `d3ff3bdb`, whose only parent is `2238c90f`. No merge of `main` is in the range, so there is no merge to separate and no per-file patch-id comparison to make. Four files: `SchemaForm.tsx` (+15 -1), the two ui test files (+63, +17) and the changeset (+2). `packages/spec/**` is byte-identical between the two heads. `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main` (`b0056382`) against the head is clean (tree `a095cd96`); `main` touches one PR file since the merge base, the generated `fr.source-hashes.generated.ts`, and the PR's checks run on the merge of the head into that same `main`.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Published surface.** `hookForm` is unchanged since the reviewed head. The widening judged in record 6893396284 stands as judged: right.
- **Accept set.** `HookSchema` and `HookRefusalSchema` are not in the delta. Both `{}` and an absent key were accepted for `refusals` and for `reasons` before, and both still are: right.
- **What the fix changes.** Only which of two accepted values the Studio form writes when the last entry of an optional record row is removed: absent where it wrote `{}`. A required row is unchanged: right.
- **Reach.** The record face is entered only for a form row that declares `type: 'record'` (`SchemaForm.tsx:842`), never inferred from the schema, and a row with a registered widget returns before the changed line (`:3194-3215`). Across `**/*.form.ts` three rows declare it: `object.fields` (`required: true`, `object.form.ts:132-133`), `hook.refusals` (`hook.form.ts:57`) and `hook.refusals.CODE.reasons` (`:65`). The PR body's table of three rows agrees with the tree: right.
- **Gates at read time (12:33Z).** Every check-run on the head is `completed/success`, `completed/skipped` or `in_progress`; none is red. Success: Lint · ESLint, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · CI, release & engine gates, the three `Lint · scoped` runs, Type Check · source gates, Spec property liveness, Check Changeset, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Check PR Size, Build UI Deps, Dogfood Regression Gate, Flag docs affected by code changes, both shard planners. Still running, no conclusion: Build Core, Test Core 1/8 to 8/8, Test UI 1/16 to 16/16, Type Check · workspace, Type Check · consumer gates, Type Check · debt ledger, Type Check UI, Lint UI, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI. The new pins run inside the unfinished Test UI shards, so their verdict on this head is not in. This record does not stand in for them: landing waits for every check to end green.

### ② Semver level

The changeset gains one paragraph and changes no package or level: `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/console` stay at `patch`. The renderer change ships in `@object-ui/app-shell` (through `@object-ui/console`), already listed.

Clause-②: yes (widening) still holds: the delta touches no published spec file.
Metadata-protocol: none still holds: the delta adds and removes nothing an author can write. The new paragraph's two sentences on how `{}` and absent read apart agree with the code (④). The level matches.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Routing.** Handoff 6894324874 names `review#1` and this head. No other claim or record names this head. The prior reviewer session is another account's; the delta passes to this seat by that handoff.
- **Independence.** The PR is dispatched and implemented under `os-project-manager`; this seat sits under `os-elon-musk`.
- **Author:** the PR's `user.login` is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`. No off-relay note.
- **SQL pushdown:** the delta adds no data access. Nothing to record.
- **Draft:** the PR is a draft at read time.
- **Earlier notes N1 and N2 (record ID: 6893396284).** N1 is carried by #33803 (open). N2 was an accepted deviation. The delta moves neither line.
- **Tests not run here.** `Local-runs: none`: the ablations and counts in the PR body are the dev's account and are not re-measured in this record.

### ④ Design judgment

**`packages/spec/src/data/hook.form.ts`** (the `hits` file, unchanged in the delta), against what the renderer now stores. The `reasons` row's help text reads "Absent: a thrown reason is not read". At the reviewed head the form could leave `reasons: {}` behind an empty list, which made that sentence false for what the screen showed. At this head an emptied `reasons` is written absent, so the sentence describes the state the form produces. The row needed no edit.

**`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/SchemaForm.tsx`** (implementing).

- `FieldControl` passes its existing `offerUnset` (`!required && !listElement`, `:2231`) to `RecordField` (`:2298`), and `RecordField.emit` writes `undefined` when `offerUnset` holds and the next map has no keys (`:3234-3235`). Every write of the inline face goes through `emit` (`updateItem`, `removeItem`, `renameItem`, `addItem`, `reorder`); only `removeItem` can produce an empty map, so nothing else changes.
- Top level (`refusals`): `required` is the form row's flag or, failing that, the schema's `required` list (`:1732`). `refusals` is optional in both, so `onChange(undefined)` reaches `setField`, which deletes the key (`:1254-1260`). The stored hook has no `refusals`.
- Nested (`reasons`): the sub-row's `required` is the form row's flag (`:3438`), unset here, so the entry's `updateItem` writes `reasons: undefined` into the entry (`:3237-3243`). The page's dirty check and the save both go through JSON, which drops it (`ResourceEditPage.tsx:2443-2449`), so the stored entry has no `reasons` and add-then-remove compares equal to the stored hook. This is the convention the comment at `:2225-2230` already states for the enum unset.
- `object.fields` is `required: true`, so `offerUnset` is false and it keeps `{}`.
- The two readings the code comment and the changeset state are true of the schema. `refuseUndeclaredLiteralRefusalCode` returns early only when `refusals` is missing (`hook.zod.ts:309`); a `{}` catalogue is a declared one, so every literal code the source throws is refused, and a hook whose code cannot throw one is refused at `refusals`. Under a code, `if (!reasons || hasOwnProperty…) continue` (`:330`) skips a missing `reasons` and refuses every literal reason under `{}`. So the fix moves `refusals` in the same direction as `reasons`, and extending it to that row is correct, not scope creep: the same defect, one level up, on the same face.
- A stored `{}` is not rewritten on load. Nothing emits until the author acts, so opening and saving a hook that already holds `reasons: {}` or `refusals: {}` stores it as it was.
- One boundary, no effect on this tree: a nested record row reads `required` from the form row only, not from the schema. A nested record key the schema requires but the form row does not mark would be written absent and then refused by the schema at save, loudly. No form declares such a row.

S1: closed

**The two ui test files** (implementing: the pins). The Studio pins cover add-then-remove, removing the last stored reason (with `params` kept), removing one of two (control), and removing the only code (`not.toHaveProperty('refusals')`). The `SchemaForm` pins cover the optional row written absent with `HookSchema` parsing the result, and the same row declared `required: true` keeping `{}`. Each pin asserts the stored value, which is where the defect lived. Their green on this head is owed by the Test UI shards.

**`packages/spec/src/system/metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts`**: unchanged in the delta; the judgment in record 6893396284 stands.

No must-fix, no should-fix.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `2e0174a80638baa46bfd1b70fd73b12c5b6d864c`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/data/hook.form.ts + ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/SchemaForm.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.hookRefusalReasons-33657.test.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/SchemaForm.keyOnlyRecord-26835.test.tsx, packages/spec/src/system/metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts

Merge-only delta record, taken on handoff 6894405815 under claim 6894437852. It carries the PASS of record 6894383458 (head `d3ff3bdbe9d993dc085875193bacc72c9e187724`) to this head. Nothing was built or run locally: the measurements below are git object reads and the head's check-runs.

Inputs read: PR #33796 (body, 22 files, comments up to 6894437852), card #33657, the merge commit, `main` from `bd96ec9c` to `b0056382` (33 first-parent commits, 739 files), and the check-runs of both heads.

### ① Derived judgments

- **The head is a merge and nothing else.** `2e0174a8` has two parents: `d3ff3bdb` (the head record 6894383458 judged) and `b0056382`, which is the tip of `main` at read time. `git merge-tree --write-tree d3ff3bdb b0056382` exits clean with tree `a095cd96a7a88dfebaf070c1f266bec48e9b1540`, and that is the head's tree.
